description: tiktok: Profile Videos. GET /v3/tiktok/profile/videos. Get posts from a TikTok profile, newest first, 15 per page. Follow has_more and max_cursor to page back in time. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

include_pinned.description: Include pinned posts; defaults to true. false excludes them. Keep unchanged while paginating.

max_cursor.description: Cursor for the next (older) page. Use max_cursor from the previous response.

region.description: Accepted for compatibility. The US feed is read.

sort_by.description: latest (the default). popular is not supported yet and returns 400.

trim.description: Set to true for a trimmed down version of the response

user_id.description: TikTok handle or user id. Prefer handle.

name: tiktok_profile_videos
